meta.name: Scarlet & Violet—Twilight Masquerade
meta.description: Card-of-the-Day enrichment layer designed to merge with Pokémon TCG API sv6 card objects.
notes: Base card facts such as artist, rarity, attacks, abilities and flavorText should be taken from the Pokémon TCG API at runtime.
Enrichment text is original paraphrased copy, not a reproduction of Pokédex or card flavor text.
Collector tier is assigned for the secret-numbered blocks: 168–188 Illustration Rare; 189–209 Ultra Rare; 210–220 Special Illustration Rare; 221–226 Hyper Rare.
For ordinary #1–167 cards, exact rarity is intentionally left to the base API because it varies among Common, Uncommon, Rare, Double Rare and ACE SPEC.

secret_artwork_pass.purpose: Kid-friendly, card-specific visual observations for Illustration Rare, Ultra Rare, Special Illustration Rare, and Hyper Rare cards.
